h: Applied Ethics — Cases, Codes and Contemporary Dilemmas

groups.g: Dilemmas the 2026 papers are likely to reach for

items.d: An algorithm scores welfare eligibility, denies a genuine claimant, and no officer can explain why. **Frame**: accountability cannot be delegated to a model — the officer, not the vendor, owes the citizen reasons. Apply **NITI's Responsible AI principles** (safety, equality, inclusivity, privacy, transparency, accountability, protection of positive human values), the **proportionality test** from *Puttaswamy*, and insist on a **human in the loop for adverse decisions**.
items.s: NITI Aayog, Responsible AI for All

items.d: A fabricated video of a public servant circulates hours before polling. **Frame**: truth is a public good; the duty is rapid, verifiable rebuttal plus preservation of evidence, not counter-propaganda. Instruments: **IT Rules 2021 due diligence**, the **ECI's Model Code**, and the **Global Risks Report 2025** finding that misinformation is the top short-term global risk.

A department wants Aadhaar-linked profiling to target a subsidy better. **Frame**: **necessity and proportionality** — collect the least data that achieves the purpose; check for **exclusion error**, which in welfare is a harm, not a rounding difference. **DPDP Act, 2023** duties as fiduciary; *Puttaswamy (Aadhaar)* limits use to the Consolidated Fund purposes.

A project brings jobs now and imposes ecological cost on people not yet born. **Frame**: **intergenerational equity** and the **public trust doctrine** — the state holds air, water and forests as trustee, not owner. *M.K. Ranjitsinh* (2024) makes freedom from the adverse effects of climate change part of Articles 14 and 21.
items.s: M.C. Mehta v. Kamal Nath (1997) / M.K. Ranjitsinh (2024)

items.t: Gig work and the duty of the state
items.d: Platform workers carry the risk of illness and accident with no employer of record. **Frame**: the ethical question is **who bears residual risk**; a contract that allocates all of it to the weakest party is procedurally free and substantively unfair (Rawls). **Code on Social Security, 2020** first defined gig and platform work and set an aggregator contribution of 1-2% of turnover.

One ventilator, two patients; one scholarship, two deserving students. **Frame**: name the allocation rule *before* the case — first-come, greatest expected benefit, lottery, or need — and apply it transparently. An unstated rule applied case by case is indistinguishable from favouritism, however honest the officer.

You inherit a project you believe is unsound but which the district has already been promised. **Frame**: institutional continuity is a value, not an obstacle — the answer is to record your reasoned dissent, seek review through the proper channel, and avoid unilateral reversal that teaches citizens that policy follows the officer, not the office.

A regulated firm offers your department a 'CSR partnership' during a live licensing decision. **Frame**: this is **apparent conflict of interest** and potential **regulatory capture** — disclose, recuse from the licensing matter, and route the offer through a general policy rather than a bilateral arrangement. The Integrity Pact exists for exactly this.

groups.g: Exemplars and codes worth one more line

items.d: Built Amul as a **producer-owned** institution and repeatedly declined to convert its value into private gain, insisting the returns belong to the farmer-members. **Value: fiduciary stewardship — building an institution you do not own.**

Dissented alone in *ADM Jabalpur* (1976) that even in an Emergency the state cannot take life without lawful authority; the *New York Times* wrote that his name would be remembered when others were forgotten. He lost the Chief Justiceship for it. **Value: moral courage measured by what it costs.**

Insisted that farmers retain the right to save and exchange seed, which India wrote into the **PPVFR Act, 2001** against the UPOV model. **Value: technology serving the weakest stakeholder, and expertise used to protect rather than to enclose.**

Used only powers the Constitution already gave the ECI under **Article 324**, and made them real by enforcing them uniformly against every party. **Value: institutions are strengthened by consistent enforcement more than by new powers.**

items.t: The officer who wrote it down
items.d: *T.S.R. Subramanian* (2013) directed that **oral instructions be recorded in writing** — the single most practical protection an honest officer has, because it converts pressure into evidence. **Value: procedure as the shield of integrity.**

**Selflessness, integrity, objectivity, accountability, openness, honesty, leadership** — memorise the seven, and use 'openness' and 'accountability' as the pair that most often resolves a transparency dilemma.
items.s: Committee on Standards in Public Life, 1995

items.d: **Disclose → recuse → divest**, and treat *apparent* conflict as seriously as actual, because public trust turns on perception. Writing this three-step sequence explicitly is worth more than a paragraph of assertion.

The CVC's own emphasis: fix the **system that permitted** the wrong — transparency of rates, e-procurement, rotation, technology-mediated transactions — rather than only punishing the individual who exploited it. A structural remedy in the conclusion lifts any integrity answer.

**Integrity, impartiality, non-partisanship, objectivity, dedication to public service, empathy, tolerance and compassion towards the weaker sections** — the Second ARC's list, which it wanted given statutory form in a Public Services Bill. Quote the list, then apply two of them to the case.

**Self-awareness** makes recusal possible; **self-regulation** prevents escalation in a crowd; **empathy** makes grievance redress real; **motivation** sustains work without recognition; **social skill** builds the coalition a reform needs. Naming which component the case needs beats reciting Goleman's five.
